briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent AGI capabilities race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has intensified with new model releases from OpenAI and Chinese labs pushing reasoning boundaries. Funding remains robust amid regulatory scrutiny on safety. Prompt injection persists as the dominant production risk while specialized protocols emerge.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced tool-use chains; DeepSeek R2 claims parity on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-horizon planning while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variants.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce 100k H100-equivalent clusters in new Texas and Arizona sites. TSMC reports AI chip yields above 85%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged superintelligent system emerge from a US or Chinese lab by end of 2027?
